I can consistently reproduce a crash with this MRP doing some changes in the steps: 1. Open the MRP 2. Open both scenes 3. Switch to `my_base_scene` 4. Open my_base_scene in external editor and make any valid change 5. Go back to Godot and when prompted to reload, select `Ignore External Changes` 6. Switch to `my_inherited_scene` 7. Do some valid change again in `my_base_scene` 8. Ignore the external changes 9. Switch to `my_base_scene` 10. Switch to `my_inherited_scene` 11. Crash due to stack overflow between `PackedScene::instantiate` and `SceneState::instantiate` https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d64721dc-9b63-43e7-8144-3dc500201a19
